name: Wave Helper
description: Turn a wave floor into its ceiling (or back) in one click, with the slope hitboxes facing the right way.

gap.name: Starting Gap
gap.description: How many blocks apart the new ceiling (or floor) starts from the original. You can drag it anywhere afterwards since it stays selected.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: <cy>Auto</c> looks at the slopes you selected: if they're a floor it makes a ceiling, if they're a ceiling it makes a floor. Flat selections with no slopes are treated as a floor.

orientation.name: Non-Slope Objects
orientation.description: How blocks and decorations are turned when mirrored. <cy>Rotate 180</c> matches what happens to slopes, so detail that follows a slope stays lined up with it. <cy>Flip vertically</c> keeps left and right the same. Slopes are always rotated 180, since that's what fixes their hitboxes.

include-triggers.name: Copy Triggers
include-triggers.description: Also copy triggers and start positions in the selection. Off by default so you don't end up with every trigger firing twice.

mirror-keybind.name: Mirror Shortcut
mirror-keybind.description: Keyboard shortcut for the Mirror button in the editor.
